notes.title: September 12th major update
notes.content: Now we support 5090, there was a minor bug before. I regret that as a developer, I'm just a small development indie, and I didn't have a 5090 myself, so I couldn't test it properly. Recently, I finally took out a loan to purchase a 5090, and after testing, I've now fixed the issue where 5090 couldn't run normally. I hope everyone enjoys it, and more styles will be updated later.

tags.bug: - I hope everyone enjoys it, and more styles will be updated later.

notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where task mode scores would occasionally be 0 due to network issues
   Now it's completely usable in offline mode

2. Slightly adjusted the prompts in free mode

If you have any suggestions, please mention them in the discussion section
Near-term plans:
1. Support for cloud saves
2. Da Vinci cards
3. Monet cards
4. Gauguin cards
